bio.text: Sean Casten represents Illinois's 6th District in the U.S. House and serves on the House Financial Services Committee and the Joint Economic Committee.
Before Congress he worked as a clean energy consultant at Arthur D. Little, served as president and CEO of Turbosteam Corporation, and in 2006 co-founded Recycled Energy Development.
He holds a Master of Engineering Management and a Master of Science in Biochemical Engineering from the Thayer School of Engineering at Dartmouth College.
